tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (da)༄༅/ /sa snying dang brtan ma sbrags sgrub kyi bum gter sgrub tshul phan bde'i yang snying zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/byang cha
(da)༄༅/ /sa snying dang brtan ma sbrags sgrub kyi bum gter sgrub tshul phan bde'i yang snying zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/byang cha

tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// sa snying dang brtan ma sbrags sgrub kyi bum gter sgrub tshul phan bde'i yang snying zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ byang chub sems kyi nor bu yis// phan bde'i 'dod rgu stsol mdzad pa'i// bla ma mchog dang lhag pa'i lhar// btud nas gter bum sgrub thabs bshad// 'di la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ bum pa yul gyi bre gang shong ba las mi chung ba spyin med pa'i bag phye sogs kyi dam dang bcas dkar rtsis byug mdun rtags su kṣiṃ dkar po bri/ thil du gnas rten byin can dang sa dbal can gyi sa sna chu sna dgram/ dbus su dri bzang po'i srog shing rtswa rtse ma nor ba brtan par btsugs pa la gzungs kyi shog dril dkri zhing na bza' gsol/ sku yod na'ang na bza' dang bcas te gzhug sgrub chen byas pa'i sgrub gtor/ ma ṇi ril bu/ bya rgyud lugs kyi bum rdzas nyer lnga/ snying zho sha dang mkhal ma zho sha sogs zho sha'i rigs/ klu sa bdag la gnod pa'i gla rtsi dug rigs ma 'dres pa'i sman sna/ lcags dang ra gan mu zi la sogs ma 'dres pa'i rin po che'i rigs/ 'bru nag ma gtogs pa'i 'bru sna/ shing tog sha chang ma gtogs pa'i dkar mngar dang khur ba sogs zas sna gtsang ma/ shug pa sogs bzang shing gi phye ma dang bcas pas phyur bur dgang*/ kha 'jim pas bcad cing ras dkar po la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pas g.yogs/ mgrin pa dam par bcing*/ gzungs gzhug shog dril la bri rgyu/ gzhung gi bzlas sngags rnams dang*/ nā ga phuḥ ta la ma tha snyan la tha/ mi 'dzad yun gyi gter mdzod cig /ces dang*/ dbyangs gsal rten snying*/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// zhes sogs bkra shis dang*/ su pra tiṣṭhas mtha' brgyan pa bri'o// de ltar legs par bcas grub nas gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du 'bru dkar cung zad bkram pa'i dbus su bum pa du yod bzhag thams cad 'khor ba'i gzungs thag ser po gdags/

de'i mdun du zlum gtor dkar po gnyis dang*/ mchod pa bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du las bum/ rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ grogs gzhan yod na rnga rol dung dkar sogs bsham/ gnyis pa ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra ldan par byas la/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tes bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai widyā/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar sbyar bas brlabs nas/ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs rol chen bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od 'phros pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ lus shel gong dag pa lta bur gyur/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang rje btsun seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo bhaṭṭā ra ka siṃ ta nā de bhyaḥ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi sa twe bhyaḥ oṃ bhaṭṭā ra ka siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai bi dyaṃ/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan sogs nas/ nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las seng ge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan cing gdong gyen du phyogs pa ral pa dmar po thur la 'phyang zhing rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po ring cha tshegs drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du brkyangs pa/ g.yon sku rgyab tu gdan la brten pa/ ral pa'i thor cog bcings shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas logs su sku la cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shū la ljang gu gyen du bsgrengs pa la sbrul dkar po dkris pa/ g.yon logs su padma dkar po'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang*/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas bkang ba'i thod pa dkar po can/ kriṣṇa sā ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ tshangs skud ma gtogs pa rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i nang du zla ba la hrī dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis sngar ltar mchod/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med pa'i dbur brgyan/ de nyid kyi tshe/ rigs lnga'i 'od zer 'phro ba'ang grub ste/ dbu'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad/ dpung pa g.yas par mi bskyod pa/ g.yon par 'od dpag med/ dku g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams bzhugs par gyur/ de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad la/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog dkar po bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gnod sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsiṃ ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci mang dang thun gsham du/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ārya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twa ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tadya tha/ oṃ ā ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭe ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭa/ bīrye swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du byon par bsams la/ de la tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pas/ las bum rgyas bsdus gang rigs kyis bsgrub pa'am/

a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su zla ba la sngags kyi phreng bas mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas sngags phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas mthar/ sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ yang na bsang chu/ a mṛ ta'i sngags kyis brlab/ gter bum rnams la spro na sbyong khrus rgyas par bya/ de tsam mi nus na/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur pa'i mos pa las sngags dang sum bha brjod cing*/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ yungs kar gyis brab/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pa'i khrus gsol mdor bsdus dang*/ de dag sku la sogs sku phyi ba rnams bya zhing*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang me tog 'thor/ de nas mdun rten/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba bzhi rim brtsegs kyi steng bumaṃ paṃ'i grangaṃs dngaṃ mnyamaṃ pa'iṃ pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa can rnamaṃs kyi nang rin po che dang*/

bum pa gcig las med na/ bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhes pa dang*/ 'og gi rnams zhes pa dor/ mchan/ 'bru bcud zas nor sogs kyis yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgyas sbyar ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shuddho3haṃ/ yo byad ma dgaṃ pa rnams sbyangs teṃ skyon thams cad dang bral bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de bzhin du/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i tshigs bar pa rnams bcag pa dpral bar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ mgron rnams so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad kyis nam mkha'i khams khyab par gyur/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags rgyas bsgyur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i kha gyen du phye ste mthe bong bsnol la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdzas rnams mgron so so'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgyas spyod par dbang ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgyas thob par bya ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa snying khar bzhag g.yon mthe bong lag pa'i mthil du bzhag pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ dzña na a ba lo ki te na maḥs manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dza lā ni swā hā/

lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes shing sems can rnams yo byad rgyal pham dang rtsod pa med par so so'i mos pa bzhin thob par gyur/ dbang sgyur 'khor lo'am lha mgon spyi'i phyag rgyas dbang bsgyur ba ni/ sor mo nang du bsnol ba'i rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs la/ na massamanta buddhā nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra pañtsa ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ mgron thams cad kyang dam tshig gi dbang gis bdag la 'go zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i phrin las 'ba' zhig bsgrub par gyur/ phyag rgya rnams phyogs bcur bskor zhing sngags rnams lan gsum la sogs pa brjod pas/ bum pa'i nang gi 'bru sman rin po che sogs lha so so'i thugs dang mthun pa'i yo byad zad mi shes pa'i gter dang*/ longs spyod dang bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs nas/ sku dang sngags byang sogs lhar bskyed pa ni/ de lta bu'i bum pa rnams kyi stod kyi char dbus su pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kṣiṃ yig dkar po gsal zhing snum pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las snod bcud kyi dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa sa'i snying po sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rin po che'i myu gu thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ 'gying ba dang bcas pa'i zhabs phyed skyil kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du sa'i lha mo brtan ma sku mdog gser gyi mdangs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal 'dzum zhing sgeg pa/ phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang bum pa steng 'og du 'dzin cing*/ sku stod sa nas thon pa/ rgyab tu sa bdag dbang chen sku mdog gser ltar ser ba/

zhal gcig pa la stag sprel phag sbrul te rab bzhi'i gdengs kas brjid pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas dpag bsam gyi ljon shing dang*/ g.yon 'og mas ri rab lhun po 'dzin pa/ sku smad sbrul mjug 'khyil zhing ru sbal gyi steng na brtan par bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan yid du 'ong bas spras pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du lha klu gzhi bdag pho mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ sgo bzhir shar du stag skya bo dang*/ lhor g.yu 'brug sngon mo/ nub tu bya dmar po/ byang du ru sbal rgya bo ste srung bzhi/ phyi nang gi bar mtshams thams cad du bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad/ rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs pa dang*/ lha klu mi'i longs spyod zad mi shes pas bskor ba rgya che la rgyun mi chad pa'i gter du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang sa 'og nas byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po gtso 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ hoḥ gson cig dgongs shig mngon shes can// ye shes spyan dang ldan pa po// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che// sa'i snying po dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems ma sems ma che// lha mo brtan ma dgongs su gsol// las las grub pa'i stobs po che// sa bdag dbang chen dgongs su gsol// lha 'dre yid kyi mngon shes can// yul phyogs 'di la gnas pa yi// klu dang sa bdag dgongs su gsol// de ring bdag dang yon bdag gi /'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen legs tshogs rgyas pa'i phyir// gter bdag khyed rnams spyan 'dren na// thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol// rin chen sna tshogs gter bum la// sku yi rten dang gnas mdzod cig

/yul phyogs 'di ru dus rtag tu// lo legs 'bru dang rtsa rnams 'phel// sa bcud dpal g.yang rgyas pa dang*// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi// kha 'dzin rgyab rten stong grogs mdzod// bde skyid ldan pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ kṣiṃ hi rā dza pṛ thi wī de bī sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañdza ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis sngar ltar mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo dang brtan ma la rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ de nas gong ltar mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// sa snying 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas sems can don kun mdzod// oṃ kṣiṃ hi rā dza pṛ thi wī de bī sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang*/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dyā/ shabda rnams sbyar ba dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi ta rol chen bcas bya/ de nas spro na/ oṃ sarba bitpū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ zhes dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog

/sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra bas tsakra ratna pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi ratna/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wastī ratna/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā ta ratna/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg par rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti ratna/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /a shwa ratna/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍga ratna/ zhes rgyal srid rin chen bdun dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos sa snying 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// sngags gong ltar la rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos= bzhes shig= shabda/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= gandhe/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= ra sa/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos=

bzhes shig= /sparshe/ zhes 'dod yon lnga bcas 'bul lo// bstod pa ni/ spro zhing nus na/ byang chub sems dpa'i rin chen phung po'i dbus// zhes pa nas/ mtshungs med sa yi gtso dang mtshungs par shog /ces pa'i bar gyi nye sras brgyad bstod rgya mtsho rnam brgyad kyi sa snying bstod chen dang*/ dkyus tsam du/ grangs med gong nas sangs rgyas kyang*// 'gro ba'i don du sems dpa'i tshul// sems dpa' sa yi snying po la// phyag 'tshal mchod bstod skyabs su mchi// sa brgyad la gnas sems ma che// stong gsum 'jig rten sa yi bdag /sa yi lha mo brtan ma la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi// nad gdon gnod pa zhi ba dang*// sa bcu dpal g.yang rgyas par mdzod// 'dod rgu dngos grub stsal du gsol// de nas thugs rgyud skul ba'i bzlas dmigs ni/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpag tshad brgyad khri tshun chad kyi snod bcud kyi rgud pa thams cad bsal/ dpal dang gzi byin bskyed/ bcud dang dwangs ma thams cad bsdus te mdun gyi rten rdzas rnams la thim pas sa bcud dang dge mtshan thams cad 'phel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par mos la/ oṃ kṣiṃ hi rā dza pri thi wī de wī swā hā/ zhes bsnyen pa dang*/ oṃ kṣiṃ hi rā dza pri thi wī de wī sarba siddhi swā hā/ zhes sgrub sngags ci nus dang*/ spro na/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha/ ha ra tsa ra/ ma hā pā sha/ ma ru tā/ a mo gha badzra satwa swā hā/ zhes sa'i snying po'i gzungs dang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ do tsu do tsu/ ba ha ba ha swā hā/

zhes lha mo brtan ma'i rig pa dang*/ oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a bhi la maṇḍal ma ye swā hā/ zhes nyes sel gyi sngags rnams kyang ci rigs pa bzla'o// thun mthar/ oṃ kṣiṃ hi rā dza pri di wī de wī sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ grangs med gong nas sangs rgyas kyang*// sogs gong ltar gyis bstod la/ byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsal zhing*/ yul phyogs 'dir bkra shis pa dang*/ bde legs dpal 'byor gyi dngos grub rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ gtor ma gnyis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlabs nas dang po rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dza/ zhes pas spyan drangs te/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ bhaṭṭā ra ka siṃ ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro lan gsum la sogs pas phul nas/ mtshan sngags de nyid sngon du 'gro ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis// sems can kun la gzigs pa po// stobs dang mi 'jigs mnga' brnyes pa'i// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal ba dang*/ khyad par du klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sogs dang*/ badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ gnyis pa/ oṃ kṣiṃ hi rā dza pṛ thi wī de wī sarba bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro btags pa la gsum la sogs pas phul/ mchod bstod 'dod gsol gong ltar mthar/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i me tog thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du thogs te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyad par du'ang gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsal zhing*/ yul phyogs 'dir bkra shis pa dang*/ bde legs dpal gyi dngos grub rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swā hā/ mang du brjod cing me tog 'thor bas brtan bzhugs bya/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa'i// zhes sogs bkra shis gang rigs brjod/ tshar grangs dgos na de lta bu'i sgo nas grangs gsog mthar brtan bzhugs grub rjes/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir sogs sam/ 'jig rten pa yi sa bdag rnams// rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs// lo ka bhū mi pa ti sarba gatstsha zhes 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin pa āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/'jig rten dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas// sogs bdag bskyed kyi dge bsngo dang*/ thams cad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /lha yang dus su char 'bebs shing*// lo tog phun sum tshogs par shog /rgyal po chos bzhin byed gyur cing*// 'jig rten dag kyang dar bar shog /'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bzhin// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod khyad par ba dang*/ gzhan yang*/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med// dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba// rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs dang*// phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur nas// bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /ces dang*/ gnas 'dir nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ces sogs mdo rgyud nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod pas dge legs su bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar thun du bcad la legs par bsgrubs zin pa'i bum pa yul gyi dbus/ mkhar gyi rtse/ zhing sa bzang po'i dkyil sogs sa dpal bzang por rlan gyis mi 'jig pa'i tshas dang bcas te lag tshags dam par byas la gzhug

'jug pa'i skabs su'ang cung zad spro zhing rgyas par na gong gi cho ga tshar gcig bskyar la/ sarba gatstsha'i rjes/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba lnga ni sangs rgyas dngos// sa yi lha mo mkha' phyes shig /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// sgrub pa las kyi gter sbed do// snying po rin chen sna lnga 'bru// sman sna dam rdzas gtor ma yi// yid bzhin gter mchog 'di sbas pas// 'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams// bla med byang chub ma thob bar// skye rga na 'chi'i dus byung tshe// gter mchog 'di yi byin rlabs kyis// bde thob longs spyod ldan par shog /phyag rgya lnga yis rgyas gdab bo// yon tan mtha' rgyas bkra shis shog /oṃ badzra ratna padma karma siddhi hūm̐ bhrūm̐/ rdo leb la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris pas bkab nas/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i rgyas btab pas// mi shigs mi 'gyur rab tu brtan// rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyas btab pas// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas// padma 'bar ba'i rgyas btab pas// chags med skyon bral yon tan ldan// ral gri 'bar ba'i rgyas btab pas// bdud bzhi'i bar chad rtsad nas chod// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rgyas btab pas// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhi// rgya lngas btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// sems can bde skyid ldan pa'i phyir// bstan pa'i btsas su 'di gyur cig /grogs rnams kyis sa rdos 'thas par bcag rang nyid kyis bkra shis gang shes dang*/ rten 'brel snying po dang*/ su pra tiṣṭha sogs brjod la me tog gi char dbab/ de tsam ma grub par bsdu na brtan bzhugs dang smon lam bkra shis rgyas par brjod pas 'thus shing*/ gang ltar yang las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar bgyis pas snod bcud kyi rgud pa zhi zhing*/ dpal 'byor legs tshogs thams cad rgyas par 'gyur bas mtshon phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul sa'i snying po'i gzungs mdo tshan brgya sogs bka' dang man ngag gi yig rnying rnams las shes par byas te phan bde sgrub pa'i thabs la brtson par bya'o// gnod sbyin gter 'chang mchog rnams kyi// 'dod rgu'i bum pa bzang po bzhin// gdams pa'i snying po 'di brjod dges// phan bde'i dpal yon rgyas gyur cig

/ces pa 'di ni kun gzigs bla ma de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sa bdag snying gter sgrub thabs nyid gsar ma'i 'gros bzhin bris na legs zhes gsungs pa ltar spyi khyab bum gter sgrub thabs kyi khog phub ste blo gter dbang pos bsdebs pa 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i btsas su siddhi rastu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
